root: ^As you draw closer, you find someone trapped—cornered by a swarm of slimes.
^Their eyes are wide with fear, body tense and trembling.
^"Please! Someone—anyone! I-I hate slimes! Get them away from me!"
^Despite their panic, you notice their hands glowing faintly, energy pulsing at their fingertips—but they do not strike.
^They clutch a worn-out weapon, too afraid to use it.
